source_title: ‘Nocturne’ Release Schedule: When Do New Episodes Come Out? - People.com
source_excerpt:
The new Apple TV series ‘Nocturne,’ starring Liev Schreiber, Zazie Beetz and Stephen Graham, premiered on Oct. 30
The Apple TV crime drama stars Liev Schreiber, Zazie Beetz and Stephen Graham, among others
It will include 10 episodes that air weekly on Fridays
Nocturne is set to unleash a chilling serial killer tale.
The Apple TV crime drama — based on Lars Kepler’s novel The Sandman — follows ex-soldier and homicide detective Jonah Lynn ( Liev Schreiber ), who trades working on the streets of Philadelphia for a more peaceful life in small-town Pennsylvania. However, when a serial killer ( Stephen Graham ) terrorizes the town and Jonah’s family from the depths of a psychiatric hospital, his quiet life in the suburbs quickly turns into a nightmare.
To prepare for the role, Schreiber met with real homicide detectives who “see the worst possible aspects of human nature every day,” he said during an October episode of Late Night With Seth Meyers .
Meanwhile, Graham worked on capturing a very specific physicality for his character. “I wanted to look like, if I wanted to, I could kill you with my bare hands,” he told Entertainment Weekly in October.
Zazie Beetz stars alongside Schreiber and Graham. The cast also includes Bill Camp, Rory Culkin , Chrissy Metz , Poorna Jagannathan and Gary Carr.
Here’s everything to know about the Nocturne season 1 release schedule.
Season 1 of Nocturne premiered on Oct. 30 on Apple TV.
When Graham got word of the project from director-producer Tim Van Patten , he decided to sign on, script unseen, because he had enjoyed previously working with Van Patten on the period crime drama Boardwalk Empire (2010-14), the actor told Entertainment Weekly.
“I’m a big fan of that whole crime thriller, drama, serial killer genre that I think America does magnificently,” the English actor added. “So, without hesitation, I was in.”
How many episodes are in Nocturne season 1?
Nocturne season 1 will consist of 10 episodes, per an Apple TV press release .
To embody Graham’s convicted serial killer character, the actor dove deep into his backstory.
“For this man, it was the trauma that he suffered at a young age that defines every single thing he does after that moment,” he told Entertainment Weekly . “Personally, I don’t believe that anybody is born evil. I think we are products of our environment and of society, as well as how we are brought up and what it is that we go through.”
Graham also watched a lot of true crime stories to prepare for the role, as suggested by his wife, Hannah Walters .
“I adore my wife to bits, and I say that before I say this: She’s obsessed with serial killers and real-life crime documentaries,” Graham told the outlet. “So she made me watch a lot of those so I could understand the mindset of these kind of people.”
What is the Nocturne season 1 release schedule?
Nocturne premiered with two episodes on Oct. 30.
Following the premiere, new episodes of Nocturne will be released weekly on Fridays through Dec. 25, per Apple TV.
What time do new episodes of Nocturne season 1 come out?
Apple TV has not officially confirmed what time new episodes of Nocturne will be released.
In the past, new episodes of Apple TV shows have hit the streamer at 9 p.m. ET / 6 p.m. PT the night before the official release date.
New episodes of Nocturne will be available to stream on Apple TV .
